title: 第22章 制卡师林峰
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
林奇攥着刚从城主府账房领来的五万卡恩储值卡，心里满是畅快。

    “给有钱人办事就是不一样，这酬劳比预想的多了整整三万。”

    他低头看向脚边的风铃猫，笑着问道：“小风铃，你不会怪我选了卡恩，没选你的进阶材料吧？”

    “喵喵。”

    风铃猫抬起头，尾巴轻轻晃了晃，蹭了蹭林奇的裤腿，依旧是那副优雅乖巧的模样，显然没听懂方才他和艾丽西亚的对话。

    “放心，那进阶材料我都看了，虽然能让你提升到三星，但品质依旧是绿色。与其选择那废物材料，还不如我亲自给你搭配进化路线。”

    “喵~”

    风铃猫应了一声。

    作为林奇的卡兽，它虽然听不懂具体的话，却能清晰感受到主人对自己的关怀，小脑袋往林奇身上又蹭了蹭。

    没错，林奇已经想好要将风铃猫作为自己的永久副卡了。

    虽说他以前梦想中的卡兽是能带着自己飞行的类型，但又没有人规定御兽只能有一只。

    反正他以后会越来越强，每晋升一颗星级都能在卡槽空间内开辟出新的位置，留个位置给风铃猫一点问题都没有。

    ……

    “开业大酬宾！全场九九折啊！”

    林奇刚走到奇妙物语商铺的街道，一阵喧闹声就扑面而来。

    他放眼望去，只见商铺门口围满了人，里三层外三层，挤得水泄不通。

    林峰正站在柜台前，手里拿着一张佣兵佩剑卡，扯着嗓子叫卖。

    “一星器具卡佣兵佩剑，不要两千，不要两百，只要一百九十八！你没听错，就是一百九十八卡恩，买到就是赚到！”

    “老板，这佣兵佩剑在万卡阁买也只需要二百卡恩，你就便宜两卡恩，是不是太小气了。”

    “什么？便宜两卡恩是小气吗？”

    林峰眼睛一瞪，提高了音量。

    “一卡恩就能够你买一桶麦酒，两卡恩让你多喝两杯，这还不够啊！”

    “而且我这器具卡都是有保障的，现场付钱现场试用，要是比万卡阁的差，我直接退钱，还额外赔你十卡恩！

    见周围人还在犹豫，林峰直接喝了一口杯子里的红墨水。

    “噗~~”

    表演了一副满天喷血后，他继续喊道：“大家都是佣兵团的兄弟，今日吐血价，一百九十五卡恩！”

    这戏剧性的一幕，瞬间点燃了人群的热情。

    一个穿着佣兵服的年轻小伙率先掏出储值卡，挤到柜台前。

    “老板，我来一张！”

    “好小子。”

    林峰眼睛一亮，立刻收起痛苦的表情，拍了拍小伙的肩膀。
content_en:
Lin Qi clutched the 50,000 Kahn stored-value card he had just received from the accounting office of the City Lord's Mansion, feeling very happy in his heart.

    "It's different to work for rich people. The reward is a full 30,000 yuan more than expected."

    He looked down at the Wind Chime Cat at his feet and asked with a smile: "Little Wind Chime, you don't blame me for choosing Kahn instead of your advanced materials, do you?"

    "Meow meow."

    The wind chime cat raised its head, swayed its tail slightly, and rubbed Lynch's trouser legs. He still looked elegant and well-behaved, and obviously didn't understand the conversation between him and Alicia just now.

    "Don't worry, I've seen all the advanced materials. Although it can upgrade you to three stars, the quality is still green. Instead of choosing that waste material, it's better for me to personally match you with an evolutionary route."

    "Meow~"

    The wind chime cat responded.

    As Lynch's stuck animal, although it couldn't understand the specific words, it could clearly feel its owner's care for it, and its little head rubbed against Lynch again.

    That's right, Lynch has already thought about using Wind Chime Cat as his permanent secondary card.

    Although the card beast he dreamed of before was one that could fly with him, no one stipulated that there could only be one card beast.

    Anyway, he will get stronger and stronger in the future. Every time he reaches a star level, he can open up a new position in the card slot space. There is no problem at all in leaving a position for Wind Chime Cat.

    …

    "Big opening offer! 10% off on everything!"

    As soon as Lin Qi walked to the street of the Wonderful Story store, a burst of noise hit him.

    He looked around and saw that the door of the shop was crowded with people, with three floors inside and three floors outside. It was packed to the rafters.

    Lin Feng was standing in front of the counter, holding a mercenary sword card in his hand and shouting at the top of his lungs.

    "One-star equipment card mercenary sword, not two thousand, not two hundred, just one hundred and ninety-eight! You heard it right, it is one hundred and ninety-eight kahn, you can earn it if you buy it!"

    "Boss, this mercenary sword only costs 200 Karns when bought at Wanka Pavilion. You only get two Karns cheaper. Aren't you too stingy?"

    "What? Is it stingy to buy two kahns for free?"

    Lin Feng's eyes widened and he raised his voice.

    "One carn can buy you a barrel of ale, and two carn can buy you two more drinks. That's not enough!"

    "And my equipment card is guaranteed. You can pay on site and try it out on site. If it's worse than Wanka Pavilion's, I'll refund your money directly and compensate you an extra ten calories!

    Seeing that the people around him were still hesitating, Lin Feng took a sip of the red ink in the cup.

    "Pfft~~"

    After performing a show of spitting blood all over the sky, he continued to shout: "We are all brothers in the mercenary group. The price of spitting blood today is one hundred and ninety-five kahn!" "

    This dramatic scene instantly ignited the enthusiasm of the crowd.

    A young man wearing a mercenary uniform took out his stored-value card first and squeezed to the counter.

    "Boss, let me take one! "

    "Good boy. "

    Lin Feng's eyes lit up, he immediately put away his painful expression and patted the young man on the shoulder.
